beats.say: Did you know Anuel AA was born on 26 November 1992?
Born Emmanuel Gazmey Santiago, he adopted the stage name Anuel AA.
He launched his debut album Real Hasta la Muerte on 17 July 2018.
His third studio album Las Leyendas Nunca Mueren arrived on his birthday, 26 November 2021, with sixteen tracks.
The follow up LLNM2 dropped on 9 December 2022, continuing his gritty style.
Which Anuel AA era defines your playlist?
